surface_name: System user tokens and Page edges
title: System user token gets 'Invalid OAuth 2.0 Access Token' on Page endpoints
symptoms: Invalid OAuth 2.0 Access Token on /{page-id}/... calls
The same token reads Instagram media fine
cause: Page edges need a Page access token. A system user token is not one, and the error looks like expiry though the token is valid.
fix: Exchange the system user token for the Page token and use that for Page calls.
apply: GET /{page-id}?fields=access_token with the system user token, then call Page edges with the returned access_token
